Bill.BriefDescription: Increasing the number of superior court judges in Yakima county.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to increasing the number of superior court judgesin Yakima county; amending RCW 2.08.063; and creating a new section.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecAmd.BegSecText: RCW 2.08.063 and 2005 c 95 s 1 are each amended to read asfollows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: There shall be in the county of Lincoln one judge of the superiorcourt; in the county of Skagit, four judges of the superior court; inthe county of Walla Walla, two judges of the superior court; in thecounty of Whitman, one judge of the superior court; in the county ofYakima, ((eight)) nine judges of the superior court; in the county ofAdams, one judge of the superior court; in the county of Whatcom, threejudges of the superior court.

The additional judicial position created bysection 1 of this act in Yakima county becomes effective only if thecounty through its legislative authority documents its approval of theadditional position and its agreement that it will pay out of county p. 1 SB 6415funds, without reimbursement from the state, the expenses of suchadditional judicial position as provided by statute.
